'''Luce''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] who was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and a member of the [[Witches of Dathomir]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]]. In [[20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Luce was one of the various Nightsisters who fought in the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]] between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the Nightsisters. As the battle raged on, Luce was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], becoming one of the many Nightsisters who were slain.

==Biography==
A [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]<ref name="Species" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the<ref name="Massacre" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], Luce was a member of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] during the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Massacre" />

[[File:BattleofDathomir-AAT.png|thumb|left|300px|Luce and a Nightsister stand atop an Armored Assault Tank piloted by Ventress]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic, the former Nightsister and [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was betrayed by her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> Returning to the Nightsisters, Ventress and her [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]] made several attempts on Dooku's life as revenge.<ref name="Nightsisters" /><ref name="Witches">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Massacre Date" /> in retaliation, the [[Count/Legends|count]] sent the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|eradicate]] the Nightsisters. Along with Ventress and<ref name="Massacre" /> her<ref name="EpGuide" /> fellow Nightsisters, Luce began a counterattack against the Separatist forces. Ventress ordered Luce and a fellow Nightsister to climb upon the branches of a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] and shoot at the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] below with their [[Nightsister energy bow/Legends|Nightsister energy bows]]. After the Nightsister elder [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]] unleashed the Nightsister [[Army of the Dead/Legends|Army of the Dead]], Luce jumped from the branches of the tree, fought two [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], and took their [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] after being deprived of her [[Bow/Legends|energy bow]].<ref name="Massacre" />

[[File:GrievousVsVentress-Massacre.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Grievous and Ventress duel, which Luce witnesses]]
After the Separatists fired two [[Defoliator/Legends|defoliators]] from a [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]], Luce and the other Nightsisters ran to cover. Luce rode upon the top of a stolen Separatist [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] and shot at the droids ahead with a new energy bow. She watched as General Grievous [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Ventress, and as Ventress was defeated and wounded, Luce retreated to help Ventress from the battlefield. However, a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt shot from a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] struck her back. She fell down and begged Ventress to save herself before [[Death/Legends|dying]] shortly after. Ventress avenged her death by destroying the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that killed her. However, Grievous stormed the [[Nightsister fortress]] and slaughtered all the Nightsisters except Nightsister [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and Ventress herself.<ref name="Massacre" />

==Personality and traits==
Luce had [[Color/Legends|white]] skin, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore black clan [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].<ref name="Massacre" />

==Powers and abilities==
Luce was able to jump from the branches of trees. She also used [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], defeating two commando droids with one kick and breaking one of the arms of one such droid. Luce exhibited several [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], as shown when she used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|crush]] three super battle droids. She was capable with Nightsister energy bow and was able to shoot two guns at a rapid speed.<ref name="Massacre" />

==Equipment==
Luce owned a Nightsister energy bow and wore a red [[Clothing/Legends|bodysuit]], red pants, red [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], two [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]], and red boots.<ref name="Massacre" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Luce-ConceptArt.png|thumb|right|250px|Polina Hristova's concept art of Luce]]
Luce was created for "[[Massacre]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="Massacre" /> released on [[February 24]], [[2012]].<ref name="Insider131">{{InsiderCite|131|Launchpad}}</ref> Prior to the episode's release, she was first pictured in [[September]] [[2011]] as part of a [http://www.starwars.com/watch/tcw_s4_cntrailer.html promotional trailer] for the season.<ref name="Season 4 Trailer">{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-season-4-trailer|text=The Clone Wars Season 4 Trailer}}</ref> She was first identified as Luce in the accompanying [[StarWars.com]] [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]] for "Massacre."<ref name="EpGuide" /> In the episode, she was voiced by [[Jaime King]].<ref name="Massacre" /> During the episode's production, Luce was modeled by [[Polina Hristova]], who reused the model "Nightsister Fem Med B" from the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|season three]] episode "[[Nightsisters (episode)|Nightsisters]]," with several changes in the model's eye color, hair style, and face texture.<ref name="EpGuide" />
